lines.en: : Are you two going to explain why you’re here? Or are you just going to keep staring at me without saying anything?
So, I guess this is my life now.
Rin and Noriko wasted no time at all coming here, following me straight from the classroom as soon as the final bell rang.
It has been roughly three minutes of silence since they closed the door, meaning neither one of them has said a word yet.
I give it three more minutes before I need to sacrifice one of them as a show of strength to send the other one running away.
But which one should it be?
Sacrifice Noriko
: I’m sorry, Noriko. But you are going to have to die.
: Tch! Damn it!
: Pay up, Rin. A deal’s a deal- and I win even if it means I am going to be sacrificed.
: If there is anything I have learned from killing hookers in Grand Theft Auto, it’s that you always get your money back once they die.
: I feel like I am missing a lot of context right now.
Sacrifice Rin
: I’m sorry, Rin. But I need to sacrifice you.
: Hah...damn it.
: Hell yeah! Thanks so much, Sensei! I’m now 500 yen richer thanks to you!
: You’re...what?
: We made a bet to see whose name you’d say first. I’m not sure we would have if we knew it was going to result in one of us dying, but hey. A bet’s a bet.
: What an exciting and productive use of your time. I completely understand why you came directly to my office after school now and not to...whichever room the light music club practices in.
: Noriko and I are taking the day off. No practice for us, Sensei.
: Well...it’s less “taking the day off” and more “giving Otoha some time alone with Sana.”
: Non-sexual time, of course. I made sure to check. You never know what kind of tricks Sana might be hiding up her sleeves.
: And why exactly does Otoha need time alone with Sana?
: Sana’s still really weak when it comes to drums and Otoha has a fair bit of experience, so we’re dedicating today to some one-on-one training.
: But mostly because we’d probably just get in the way and Otoha needs to focus when she’s doing stuff like that.
: Also, it’s not really one-on-one since Chika is there..but still.
: Interesting that Chika stayed behind if the two of you decided to abstain. Seems like she’s a lot closer to you two than either of them.
: We’re really only “abstaining” because we’ve already been yelled at once- the last time Otoha tried to help Sana.
: Us being here is what’s safest for everyone right now.

: Just hope Chika doesn’t wind up getting on her nerves. I’m not sure how Otoha feels about someone just looming in the background, but that would make me feel weird as hell if I was the one tutoring.
: Chika will be totally fine. She’s good at reading people.
: Well...not good enough to realize when someone she’s close to has a crush on her. But, hey. Same.
: I’d be worried about Sana if anything. She doesn’t exactly shine in social situations. Let alone social situations with girls she hasn’t spoken to much.
: Oh, stop. Otoha’s a great teacher and I’m sure that Sana is completely fine.
She was not fine.
: Sana, chill. It’s fine to play a little slower when you’re just starting out.
: Just focus on keeping a steady rhythm going and add speed once you’re more comfortable with how everything feels.
: If you keep trying to act like Travis Barker, you’re gonna burn yourself out and never want to play again.
: Travis...who?...
: Just...some guy who plays too fast. Don’t worry about it.
: Fact is, you’re really not bad. A lot better than I expected you to be at least. It’s clear you’ve got some understanding of music and, in time, I’m sure you’ll be solid.
: Just gotta...not work yourself too hard for the time being.
: I’m sorry...I know I’m the one...holding everyone up...
: You’re the only one without any experience. If you weren’t holding us up, it would mean that we suck.
: Maybe she should try playing along with a song instead of your metronome thingy? Music’s supposed to be, like, something you feel. Right?
: I obviously can’t speak for Sana, but I can’t bring myself to get excited hearing “click...click...click” over and over.
: Well, it’s a good thing you’re not the one playing then.
: Jeez. Hostile much? I’m just trying to help.
: And the article I pulled up says a lot of drummers have a ton of success early on by just learning to play along with songs they like.
: Oh, okay. It must be true if you found an article.
: Umm...

: I’m sure there are plenty of people who benefit from that method, but it’s a lot better to drill the basics into your head rather than just bypassing the training period and hoping to pick them up along the way.
: S...Sorry to interrupt, but would any of you happen to know where...Rin Rokuhara is?
: Huh?
: Rin? I can text her and find out. You a new teacher or something?
: Uhh...not quite...
: Wait...
: Aren't you her mom?!
: Because you look crazy familiar and I’m like, 99%% sure I saw you drop her off at middle school a few times.
: Rin’s...mom? You’re here? At school? Right now?
: Hahah...Guilty as charged...
: Uhh...okay. Hi.
: I’m...Otoha Okakura.
: Rin’s...girlfriend.
: It’s...really nice to finally meet you.
: Oh, shit!
: And I’m Chika Chosokabe. Rin’s friend.
: Oh...shit.
: Welp, I can see that I’m not needed here. But it was nice meeting you!
: I’m sorry, I...I probably should have realized that you and Rin would be in the same club. She’s going to kill me if she finds out I met you like this.
: Rin is? No way. She’s been gung-ho about getting me to meet you and your partner for months now.
: Ahh, yes...the partner I still have.
: I should be the one apologizing for delaying things for so long. I just...well, you see, my parents aren’t as “progressive” as you two and-
: And...
: Mrs...Rokuhara?...
: Not now, not now, not now! Any time but now!
: ...and that’s exactly why soy-based protein is extremely good for you so long as you work out a proper diet!
: Stop trying to convert me, Noriko. I get enough of that out of Yasu.
: There’s a difference between conversion and education, Sensei.
: All I’m doing is providing information that you can use to make your own decision. I’d never judge you for having a different opinion than me.
: That’s weird because your sister judges me for having literally any opinion at all.
: Yeah, that’s just her archetype. I’m the exact opposite. I would never be mean to you because I’m worried it would impede the amount of time I am able to spend in your presence.
: Stop liking me so much. It’s scary.
: Never.
: How are you doing over there, Rin? You went silent after Noriko started talking about vegetarianism and just never recovered.
: Chika’s being weird. I think something is going on in the club room.
: Are Otoha and Sana making out? Is that why Otoha was so insistent on-
: OH, FUCK!
: I HAVE TO GO!
: Wow. Maybe they actually were making out.
: Poor Rin. Just can’t catch a break.
: Anyway...it’s just the two of us now...I sure hope no one takes advantage of me...
: We both know you’d pull back the second I try.
: Probably. But you can take solace in knowing that I’d kick myself for it while rubbing one out later.
: But, undying desire to be with you under only the most perfect of circumstances aside, what do you wanna talk about now that we’re alone?
: Halloween’s coming up. You going to dress up this year?
: Do I really look like the type of person to dress up for Halloween?
: You look like the type of person I want to dress up for Halloween.
: I’m a little more interested in what you’ll be wearing. Going to raid your sister’s closet and then beg for me to finger you again?
: Hey, that’s mean. I was going through some shit back then. Granted, I’m going through some shit right now as well. But I was going through shit back then too.

: But no. I’m hoping to make it through the entire holiday this year without trying to force something to happen between us. Which allows me to perfectly segue into the reason for all of that- my darling sister.
: What about her?
: How are things with you two?
: What do you mean?
: You know exactly what I mean. I want to know if you guys are in love again yet.
: I’m sure Niki will waste no time at all in telling you if we are.
: She already talks about you all the time. The only side I don’t fully understand is yours.
: Are you, like...waiting for something? Because I could have sworn her letters would have been the nail in your coffin.
: I don’t want to talk about this with you, Noriko.
: Is it because I’m around the same age she was when she used to give you blowjobs under the blanket on our living room couch?
: It’s because the only relationship I want to talk about with you is the one that we have.
: Not the one I have with some other Nakayama who apparently used to give me blowjobs under the blanket on your living room couch.
: Sounds like they were pretty bad blowjobs if you can’t even remember. I promise to work a little harder and make mine memorable once I’m done with all of this self-sacrificing.
: Uh-huh. And when will that be?
: Sometime after Halloween, hopefully.
: I’ve been feeling really hot lately...and I'm not sure how much longer I can keep it all in.
: Mom.
: Heeeeeey, Rin. Nice to...be in the same...building as you...for the first time today...
: What do you think you’re doing?
: Oh, you know...a little crying...a little...more crying...
: And the suit?
: That interview you had...
: Where was it?

: L-Look at it this way! If your club goes any longer without an advisor, it might get shut down! And it’s better off having somebody who knows what they’re talking about than some random person, right?!
: Mom! How am I supposed to have a fun and exciting high school life if you’re there too?! You’re 43 years old!
: Stop spreading misinformation! I’m 42 and you know it!
: You’ve still lived my entire life more than twice! You don’t need to live it a third time! Let me have this!
: Rin...why didn’t you tell me?
: I guess you found out.
: Yeah. And now I feel like an asshole for making your mom cry within five minutes of meeting her.
: It’s my fault. I should have stayed in the dorm. Oh, and by dorm, I mean a different dorm. Not the one you guys live in since I am 42 and living there would be wrong.
: Is she actually 42?
: She’s 43.
: That’s it! You’re grounded! Go to our room!
: Phpbhpbhpbt!
: Rin, seriously. What’s going on?
: I really wasn’t trying to hide anything from you, Otoha...
: I didn’t even know until super recently, so...this is all pretty messed up for me as well. I haven’t even finished wrapping my head around everything yet.
: Do you...wanna like...like, talk about it or something?
: Yeah, but...not with my mom here.
: Maybe...after practice then?
: I still have to teach Sana how to-
: No. Go talk now. Waiting on things never helps.

: Oh, and neither do flowers apparently, so don’t go buying each other roses or something. It’ll just make you look like a loser whose only redeeming factor is how good she is at- nope. Shouldn’t say that.
: Anyway, I’m still unemployed technically, but I know my way around instruments.
: I’ll hang out here while you two go do cutesy girlfriend stuff. Love is stupid. I hate this.
: Can we...talk later too? Please?
: I still have...a lot of questions...
: Yeah. We’ll talk tonight.
: I’ll pick up a pizza on the way home.
: Pepperoni, please.
: Are there even other toppings?
